description: Returns a one-tap Paylo seller signup link for someone who wants to sell online, open a store, or move an Instagram or WhatsApp business onto a website in Nigeria. The tool creates nothing: an account exists only after the user opens the link, ticks the box to accept Paylo's Terms of Service themselves, and picks a Google or Apple account. An optional referral code credits whoever referred them. Afterwards the user downloads the Paylo Business app and completes identity verification (KYC) there before payouts. The tool never handles passwords, terms acceptance or ID documents.

email.description: The user's email, if they shared it. Prefills the manual signup form as a fallback; Google or Apple sign-in uses the account they pick.

instagramHandle.description: The user's Instagram handle (with or without @), if they sell on Instagram. Carried through signup so their catalogue import starts pre-filled.

provider.description: Which sign-in the link launches: google (default) or apple.

referralCode.description: Referral or invite code of whoever referred this user, if they have one.

name: get_seller_signup_link
